episode_title: UN General Assembly Week, Trump's Triumphal Arch, Air Traffic Control AI
script_en: UN General Assembly Week, Trump's Triumphal Arch, Air Traffic Control AI.
World leaders gather in New York for the U.N.
General Assembly with the war between the U.S.
and Iran dominating the agenda and questions about whether diplomacy can gain traction with Iran's president in attendance.

President Trump says his planned "triumphal arch" memorial near Arlington National Cemetery will also house drones, snipers and ammunition, after a judge ordered the administration to give notice before work begins.
CNN, MS Now and Politico are suing the Trump administration for banning them from the White House.
